parsed.rationale: Both `WXYCBackground.wxycBackgroundDark` (BackgroundGradient.swift:30) and `WXYCGradient.wxycBackgroundDark` (WXYCGradient.swift:31) are exact-duplicate computed properties living in the same package (WXUI). Neither is test, codegen, mock, or sample-app code. The duplication suggests the property was copy-pasted when one of the two types was introduced. The cleanest Swift resolution is to extract the shared implementation into a single location — either a protocol with a default implementation or a free function/extension in a dedicated file within WXUI — and have both `WXYCBackground` and `WXYCGradient` delegate to it, eliminating the redundant definition.
